VX.1.description: Linked-worktree routing and the tree root (closes L1-1, L1-1d, L1-13, L2-14 lazy part; IC-004, IC-006, IC-009, IC-016, DEC-030). No dependencies. - `src/cli/runtime-commands.ts:136`: add `'retrieval-plan'` to `FEATURE_STORE_VERBS`. At `:267` pass `slug: storeSlug, stateRoot: storeRoot, sourceRoot: evidenceRoot(o)`. At `:217` and `:218` add `sourceRoot: evidenceRoot(o)`. VX.7 consumes the retrieval-plan `sourceRoot`. - `src/runtime/cli.ts`: `handleEvidenceCommand` (`:376`) and `addEvidence` (`:249-320`) take `sourceRoot`, defaulting to `root`. When the batch holds an absence and `path.resolve(sourceRoot) !== path.resolve(root)`, compute `absenceTreeState = measureTreeState(sourceRoot)` and pass `ctx.absenceTreeState` and `ctx.probeRoot = sourceRoot` into `toEvidence`. At `:318` print "not measured" when `treeState.prefix !== null` and `gitCommit` is null, and "not a git worktree" only when prefix is null. `handleReadinessCommand` (`:92`) takes `sourceRoot` and passes `treeRoot: sourceRoot` to `evaluateTaskReadiness`. - `src/runtime/candidate.ts` absence branch (`:452-476`): use `ctx.absenceTreeState || treeState` and `getProviderFreshness(provider, ctx.probeRoot || root, ctx)`. In the candidate path (`:413-423`) set `rawItem.absence = candidate.absence ?? ctx.absence` when either is defined (L1-13). - `src/runtime/freshness.ts`: the `FreshnessValidator` constructor accepts `treeRoot` (default `repoRoot`), and `:130` and `:179` measure on `treeRoot`. `:179` becomes lazy: measure on the first FRESH `result: 'EMPTY'` item, at most once per pass (L2-14). At `:183-185`, when a check returns STALE, also set `item.freshness.staleReason = check.reason`, in memory only. - `src/runtime/readiness.ts`, `evaluateTaskReadiness` only (`:458-474`): `new FreshnessValidator({ repoRoot: projectRoot, treeRoot })`, with `treeRoot` from the function args. No other line of that file changes here.

VX.2.description: Source-version robustness and fingerprint coverage (closes L2-2, L2-12, L1-15, L1-5, L2-1; IC-004, DEC-027, DEC-028). No dependencies. - `defaultGitRunner` (`src/runtime/source-version.ts:53-64`): add `maxBuffer` of 256 MiB; the timeout stays 2000 ms (DEC-028). - `measureTreeState` (`:87-99`): when `status` returns null and `workTreeTop` exists, run `rev-parse HEAD` through the same runner and keep its `gitCommit`, with `dirty` and `fingerprint` null. - `:147-157`: leave entries whose path starts with `prefix + '.doflow/state/'` out of `entryRecords` (they still go into `dirty`). - `sourceVersionFor` (`:211-213`): `path.posix.normalize(prefix + file-in-posix)` with a leading `./` stripped. An absolute locator gets `isDirty: null`. - DEC-027: fold each `S` entry (including `S.M.`) and each `? <dir>/` entry holding a `.git` into the fingerprint through filesystem reads only (inner `HEAD` and index `mtimeMs`, no extra spawn). A project root below the work-tree top that its parent repo ignores gives `fingerprint: null`. - New `test/runtime/source-version-spawns.test.js`: patch `child_process.execFileSync` with a counter before requiring `src/runtime/candidate.ts`, call `clearTreeStateCache()`, then call `toEvidence` for 3 file items.

VX.3.description: Plan record and attempt correctness (closes L1-3, L1-12, L1-10, L2-10, L2-11, L1-2, L2-6; IC-013, IC-014, IC-020, DEC-024, DEC-026). No dependencies. - L1-3: `declaredIntentList(plan, sep = ', ')`. In the command text of `resolveNeed` (`src/runtime/retrieval-record.ts:94`, `:105`) use `sep = ','`. Update the expected string at `test/runtime/runtime-retrieval-plan.test.js:544`. - L1-12: in `attemptPlan` (`src/runtime/retrieval-plan.ts`), a missing `--status` gives "--status is required: EMPTY, UNREACHED or UNVERIFIED". After `:632`, refuse when the reason is not allowed for the status, naming the allowed codes (IC-013). At `:671-676` map indexState STALE to `index-stale`, as UNKNOWN is mapped. - L1-10: in the report grouping (`:404`, `:412`, `:415`), encode "no provider" as a sentinel rather than `''`. The derived attempt gets `provider: null, role: 'primary'`. - L2-10: before `updatePlan` (`:387`), collect the providers of bound positive items missing from `record.providers` and probe them outside the lock, through `module.exports._probe`. Inside `build`, only merge the results. - L2-11: in the `build` closures (`:388`, `:683`), when `disk` is null throw "the retrieval plan for task X was removed during the update; re-declare it". Extract the closures as exported pure `applyReport(disk, ...)` and `applyAttempt(disk, ...)`. - L1-2 (DEC-024): in `deriveOutcome` (`src/runtime/retrieval-record.ts:180-182`) drop every derived attempt whose `evidenceIds` is empty unless it has `basis === 'report-need'`. The legacy `report --need` attempt (`retrieval-plan.ts:409-413`, `:437-444`) is written with `basis: 'report-need'`, and the `:409` condition `need.attempts.length === 0` becomes "no counted attempt". - L2-6 (DEC-026): give `updatePlan` an optional `prepare`, passed through to `updateTaskState`. `declarePlan` passes a `prepare` that, under the lock, tries `JSON.parse` on the existing file and on a parse error renames it to `<file>.corrupt-<ISO>` and prints a note. A `version` other than 1 is still refused.

VX.4.description: Readiness on an unreadable plan and message accuracy (closes L1-4, L1-8, L1-9, L2-9; IC-018, IC-019, DEC-026). Depends VX.1, which sets `staleReason` and edits another range of `src/runtime/readiness.ts`. - `src/runtime/readiness.ts:216`: wrap `readPlan` and catch `code === 'store-unreadable'`. Treat the plan as absent and add a top-level `retrievalPlan: { unreadable: true, reason }`. - `:255-257`: skip `unboundIds` when `queryBound`. - `:353-356`: branch on `item.freshness.staleReason`. `tree-changed-since-recorded` or `tree-unverifiable` gives "the working tree changed since it was recorded; re-run the lookup and record the absence again". `freshness.gitCommit === null` gives "absence cannot be established outside a git work tree; record a positive item". Otherwise the current text. - `:362-364`: use `unboundQualifying.length` and its ids.

VX.7.description: Report rechecks absences (closes L2-3, L1-11; IC-014, IC-015, DEC-025). A STALE group appends a derived `EMPTY` / `index-stale` / `STALE` attempt, and the emptied FRESH one stops counting through VX.3.
